Substitute these into \(f'=\frac{u'v-uv'}{v^{2}}\) to obtain \(f'(x)=\frac{\left(4\cos(4x)\right)\left(x^{\frac{2}{3}}\right)-\left(\sin(4x)\right)\left(\frac{2}{3}x^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)}{\left(x^{\frac{2}{3}}\right)^{2}}\).
